g.text: Monthly prices by band, tools versus services
163 paid monthly offers from 65 companies. Median: tools $199 per month, services $5,125 per month.
Source: Broadcastwell Research, What AI search visibility costs in 2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22982430. Prices seen 25 Sep 2026. CC BY 4.0.
